title: E-commerce as a share of total US retail sales (percent)

source.name: E-Commerce Retail Sales as a Percent of Total Sales (ECOMPCTSA)
source.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)

notes: Census Bureau Quarterly Retail E-Commerce Sales, seasonally adjusted, published via FRED. 2000 and 2010 are full-year figures (commonly cited as 3.86% and 4.4% of total retail sales respectively); 2025 is the Q3 2025 reading (16.4%), the most recent available at authoring time.
